model.model_name: ClementP fundus lesion segmentation U-Net SE-ResNeXt50 32x4d

input.preprocessing: clementp-source-pinned-1024-v1: RGB decode; non-black fundus-field crop at 5%-of-max threshold; bicubic longest-side to 1024; centered zero-pad to 1024 square; 0..1 scale; ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] std [0.229,0.224,0.225]. Implemented by scripts/inference/fundus_lesion_probe.py crop_and_pad.

model.license: MIT (model code/checkpoint tag as published; training-data terms unresolved - see candidate dossier)

training_dataset.name: DDR + FGADR + IDRiD + MESSIDOR + RETLES (as reported on the model card)
training_dataset.population: not documented by publisher; must not be assumed

limitations: RESEARCH status; no clinical or independent validation at install time
Connected components are unfiltered argmax regions, not validated lesions
Argmax masks are not calibrated probabilities; raw_score is always null
Device compatibility is unvalidated for every device (DOMAIN_VALIDATION_UNKNOWN)
No auditable mask artifact is persisted; only regions, areas, and provenance are stored
model.intended_use: Offline technical research only: lesion-like region localization on fundus photographs as decision-support observations requiring ophthalmic review. Never a diagnosis, never a normality claim.
model.forbidden_interpretation: Not a diagnosis, validated lesion overlay, or absence-of-disease claim.

dataset.name: IDRiD Segmentation Task 2 (lesion) TEST split
dataset.provenance: archive.org item idrid, A. Segmentation.zip, md5 804ca21196beecf7f3a433dc59d37256
dataset.overlap_disclosure: IDRiD is named in the publisher-reported training sets of the evaluated checkpoint; these metrics are overlap-disclosed comparability evidence, NOT independent validation.
dataset.patient_separation: PATIENT_SEPARATION_UNVERIFIABLE: image-level export has no patient/eye IDs.

blocking_reasons: No legally cleared patient-keyed independent validation cohort is present.
Current dedicated runtime lacks torchseg, timm, and einops.
The user-reported abnormal failure image is not present in this workspace.

observed_engineering_cases.observation: Historical offline argmax produced a 16-pixel microaneurysm-like component.
limitations: The historical box was model-raster normalized and is not valid for an original-image overlay.
The current isolated runtime cannot reproduce the run.
